name: Senec (Slovakia)
description: Nine equal horizontal stripes of white, yellow, blue, white, yellow, blue, white, yellow and blue, ending at the fly in a swallowtail whose notch reaches one third of the flag's length.
history: The flag's colours are taken from the municipal arms, as required for Slovak municipal symbols; arms and flag are registered in the Heraldic Register of the Slovak Republic under signature S-3/91.
